articles.title: A Greener City, a Better Life
articles.subtitle: 城市的绿色空间，如何改变日常生活？
articles.provenance: AI 原创示例 · 2026-10-10 · 学习用途，非官方真题

paragraphs.english: As cities expand, a growing population puts pressure on land, housing and transport. Urban planners often face a difficult choice: should an empty site become another office building or a public park? A park may appear less profitable, yet its contribution to residents' well-being can be considerable. Green spaces offer a place to exercise, meet neighbours and escape the noise of crowded streets. For people living in small flats, access to a nearby garden can make everyday life more pleasant.
paragraphs.chinese: 随着城市扩张，人口增长给土地、住房和交通带来压力。城市规划者常常面临选择：空地应该建办公楼还是公园？公园看似利润较低，却能明显改善居民的身心状态。对住在小公寓里的人来说，附近的花园能让生活更加舒适。

paragraphs.english: Trees also play a practical role. Their shade can reduce the heat people experience on a summer afternoon, while soil allows some rainfall to soak into the ground. A sustainable design considers these benefits alongside maintenance costs. However, planting a few trees is not a complete solution to pollution or flooding. Effective policy needs evidence, careful planning and long-term investment. Local authorities should assess each neighbourhood rather than assume that one design will work everywhere.
paragraphs.chinese: 树木也发挥着实际作用。树荫能减轻夏日下午的炎热，土壤则让一部分雨水渗入地下。可持续设计要兼顾这些益处与维护成本，但种几棵树不能彻底解决污染或洪涝问题。有效政策需要证据、细致规划和长期投入，并评估各个社区的实际情况。

paragraphs.english: Another concern is inequality. Wealthier districts may enjoy attractive parks, whereas disadvantaged communities have fewer safe places to relax. To promote fair access, a city could prioritise areas with limited facilities and involve residents in decisions. This approach helps preserve local knowledge and builds a sense of responsibility. Ultimately, a successful green project is not measured only by the number of trees planted. It should improve the environment while responding to the needs of the people who use it.
paragraphs.chinese: 另一个问题是资源不平等。较富裕的地区可能拥有漂亮的公园，而弱势社区缺少安全的休闲场所。城市可以优先改善设施不足的地区，并让居民参与决策。成功的绿化项目不只看种了多少树，还要改善环境并回应使用者的需求。

options: Measure success only by tree numbers.
questions.explanation: 第三段建议优先改善设施不足的地区，并让居民参与决策。

articles.title: Learning Beyond the Classroom
articles.subtitle: 技能会变化，学习也不必止于毕业。
articles.provenance: AI 原创示例 · 2026-10-10 · 学习用途，非官方真题

paragraphs.english: For many people, education once meant attending school and obtaining a qualification before entering employment. Today, technological change can alter the skills a job requires within a few years. An employee who could previously rely on familiar methods may need to adapt to new software or work with colleagues in different countries. Lifelong learning offers a way to respond to this uncertainty. It does not always require a university degree: a short course, a practical workshop or guided practice can also be useful.
paragraphs.chinese: 对许多人来说，教育曾意味着上学、获得资格，然后就业。如今，技术变化可能在几年内改变一份工作所需的技能。终身学习能帮助人们应对这种不确定性，也不一定意味着攻读大学学位：短期课程、实践工作坊或有指导的练习同样有用。

paragraphs.english: Online courses provide flexibility, especially for adults balancing work and family responsibilities. Learners can choose a convenient time and repeat difficult lessons. Nevertheless, convenience alone does not guarantee progress. Motivation often declines when a course feels disconnected from real life. To acquire a skill effectively, learners need clear goals, regular feedback and opportunities to apply what they have studied. A person learning to write reports, for instance, might practise with a realistic task instead of simply watching more videos.
paragraphs.chinese: 在线课程为兼顾工作与家庭的成年人提供了灵活性，但便利本身不能保证进步。当课程与现实脱节时，学习动力往往会下降。有效掌握技能需要明确目标、定期反馈和实践机会。例如，学习报告写作的人可以练习真实任务，而不只是不断观看视频。

paragraphs.english: Employers have a role as well. If training is available only outside working hours, some staff may struggle to participate. Organisations can allocate time for learning and encourage experienced workers to share expertise. Such support may strengthen confidence and help a team solve unfamiliar problems. However, responsibility should not fall entirely on individuals or businesses. Public libraries and community centres can offer affordable resources, making learning more inclusive. The broader aim is not merely to increase productivity, but to enable people to make informed choices throughout their lives.
paragraphs.chinese: 雇主也有责任。如果培训只能在下班后进行，一些员工可能难以参加。组织可以安排学习时间，鼓励经验丰富的员工分享专业知识。图书馆和社区中心也可提供价格合理的资源，让学习更包容。学习的目标不仅是提高生产效率，也包括帮助人们一生中作出知情的选择。

articles.title: The Value of Our Attention
articles.subtitle: 在数字生活中，为专注留一点空间。
articles.provenance: AI 原创示例 · 2026-10-10 · 学习用途，非官方真题

paragraphs.english: Digital devices have transformed the way people communicate and obtain information. A message can reach a friend in seconds, and a student can explore a vast range of learning materials without leaving home. Yet the same devices may interrupt activities that require concentration. Notifications compete for attention, encouraging users to switch between a task and a screen. The issue is not simply how much time people spend online, but whether their habits support the activities they consider important.
paragraphs.chinese: 数字设备改变了人们沟通和获取信息的方式，却也可能打断需要专注的活动。通知争夺注意力，促使用户在任务和屏幕之间切换。问题不只是花了多少时间上网，还包括使用习惯是否支持自己真正重视的事情。

paragraphs.english: One possible strategy is to establish boundaries. Someone working on a demanding assignment could silence unnecessary alerts and set aside a period for checking messages. This approach aims to minimise distraction while preserving the benefits of communication. It is also useful to evaluate which applications deserve frequent use. An application that helps a person maintain relationships serves a different purpose from one opened automatically whenever there is a spare moment. Recognising that distinction can make decisions more deliberate.
paragraphs.chinese: 一种策略是建立界限。处理复杂任务时，可以关闭不必要的提醒，并安排专门时间查看消息。这样既能减少干扰，又能保留沟通的好处。我们也可以评估哪些应用值得频繁使用，区分主动维护关系与空闲时下意识打开应用，让选择更加有意识。

paragraphs.english: Personal habits, however, are only part of the picture. Designers can influence behaviour through default settings and the way information is presented. A service that offers clear controls may help users manage their experience, whereas a confusing interface can make that harder. Greater transparency about recommendations could support informed choices. There is no single routine that suits everyone: a parent, a student and a shift worker have different needs. A balanced relationship with technology therefore depends on both thoughtful design and individual reflection, rather than on the assumption that every digital activity is harmful.
paragraphs.chinese: 个人习惯只是问题的一部分。设计者也会通过默认设置和信息呈现方式影响行为。清晰的控制选项与推荐机制透明度有助于用户作出知情的选择。适合每个人的统一日程并不存在，因此平衡的数字生活需要良好设计与个人反思。

A quiet workspace helps minimise distraction.

options: The price of a person's device.

questions.explanation: 第一段强调，应考虑数字使用习惯是否支持自己重视的活动，而不只计算上网时间。

options: Silence unnecessary alerts during demanding work.
questions.explanation: 第二段建议在复杂任务期间关闭不必要的提醒，同时安排时间处理消息。

questions.explanation: 最后一段说明，个人需求不同，平衡的数字生活取决于良好设计与个人反思。

articles.title: What Makes a Bus Service Reliable?
articles.subtitle: 公交出行与可靠的日常安排
articles.provenance: AI 原创全文分级重写 · 2026-10-13 · 参考 CEFR 阅读描述；未作教学标定，非官方真题

paragraphs.english: A town considering a new bus lane faces two different measures of success. Shop owners want customers to reach the centre quickly, while passengers want to know when they will arrive. These aims overlap, but they are not identical. A journey that takes twenty minutes one day and forty the next may be harder to plan around than a consistently slower service. Reliability therefore deserves attention alongside average speed.
paragraphs.chinese: 新公交专用道的成功标准有两种：商家希望顾客快到市中心，乘客希望到达时间可预期。平均更快但忽快忽慢的线路可能比稳定的慢车更难安排。

paragraphs.english: The proposed approach reserves a lane for buses during the morning rush. Its supporters expect a significant improvement because buses would no longer wait behind most private cars. Yet this prediction needs evidence from ordinary operating conditions. Deliveries, road repairs and queues at junctions could still delay vehicles. A short trial should record the variation in journey times, not merely the fastest trip. It should also examine whether traffic moves onto neighbouring streets.
paragraphs.chinese: 早高峰专用道可能显著改善服务，但需要日常运行证据。送货、维修和路口仍会延误；试行应记录时间波动及邻街交通变化，而不只记录最快班次。

paragraphs.english: The investment would be more effective if planners considered the whole journey. A fast bus offers limited benefit when its stop is difficult to reach or its last service leaves before evening workers finish. Resources for footpaths and later departures may compete with the lane itself. The decision should compare these alternatives against the actual needs of passengers, while recognising that one improvement cannot solve every transport problem.
paragraphs.chinese: 决策还应考虑全程体验。难到达的站点或过早停运会削弱快车价值。步道、晚班车与专用道竞争预算，需要按真实需求比较。

articles.title: The Timetable and the People It Leaves Behind
articles.subtitle: 公交出行与可靠的日常安排
articles.provenance: AI 原创全文分级重写 · 2026-10-13 · 参考 CEFR 阅读描述；未作教学标定，非官方真题

paragraphs.english: Transport planning often treats a published timetable as a neutral promise: a service exists, and residents may use it. That assumption conceals an important distinction between formal availability and usable access. A bus scheduled after a factory shift has begun does little for its workers, however frequent the route may appear in an annual report. Likewise, a stop described as nearby may require a difficult crossing that excludes some potential passengers. The apparent precision of a timetable can therefore obscure the experience it is supposed to describe.
paragraphs.chinese: 时刻表常被视为中性的服务承诺，却混淆了名义可用与实际可达。上班后才到的车、必须艰难过街才能到的站点，都会让纸面服务失去作用。

paragraphs.english: Consider a proposed redesign that removes several lightly used evening departures and transfers the resources to a busy morning corridor. Measured in passengers carried per vehicle, the change could appear effective. However, the evening passengers may have no practical alternative, whereas some morning travellers could walk or cycle. Aggregate demand does not reveal this difference in dependency. Nor does low recorded usage establish low need: an unreliable service may already have discouraged precisely the people who would benefit from an improvement. The incentives created by a narrow performance measure can thus reinforce the weakness it claims merely to observe.
paragraphs.chinese: 取消少人乘坐的晚班车、加强早高峰，可能提高每车载客量，但晚班乘客更可能没有替代选择。客流低也可能是长期不可靠造成的，单一指标会加剧这种弱点。

paragraphs.english: An equitable framework would expose these trade-offs instead of disguising them as a purely technical optimisation. Planners could combine boarding figures with interviews about missed shifts, abandoned journeys and the cost of substitutes. Such evidence would not eliminate budget constraints or guarantee consensus; it would clarify which burdens a proposal transfers and to whom. Scrutiny should also extend to the interpretation of success after implementation. If passenger numbers rise while a small group loses its only feasible route to work, the overall increase cannot by itself settle the question of whether the redesign has improved public transport as a public service.
paragraphs.chinese: 公平的评估应公开取舍，结合客流与错过班次、放弃出行、替代成本的访谈。这不能消除预算限制，却能说明谁承担损失。总客流上升不足以证明公共服务改善。

articles.title: The Offer That Was Not a Saving
articles.subtitle: 从厨房里的小浪费开始
articles.provenance: AI 原创全文分级重写 · 2026-10-13 · 参考 CEFR 阅读描述；未作教学标定，非官方真题

paragraphs.english: Nora used to choose large packs at the supermarket because the price of each item was lower. She felt pleased with her shopping until her flatmate pointed out how much they threw away. A cheap pack was not a saving if half of it remained uneaten. Nora decided to keep a record for two weeks rather than argue about which of them wasted more.
paragraphs.chinese: 诺拉爱买单价低的大包装，室友却指出经常扔掉没吃完的部分。她决定记录两周，不争论谁浪费更多。

paragraphs.english: A school canteen wants to reduce waste, but its first measurement combines two different problems. Food left in serving trays reflects how much the kitchen prepares, while food left on pupils' plates may reflect portion sizes, taste or the time available to eat. Treating both as one total makes reporting simpler, yet it can hide the reason a proposed solution fails. Better evidence begins with separating these stages.
paragraphs.chinese: 食堂总浪费量混合了备餐剩余与餐盘剩余，前者关乎准备数量，后者可能关乎份量、口味或用餐时间。分开记录更能发现原因。

paragraphs.english: The kitchen considers preparing fewer meals. This approach could reduce unsold food, but it risks leaving late-arriving pupils without a suitable lunch. Another option is offering a smaller initial portion with the opportunity to request more. That requires staff time and a queue that does not discourage pupils from returning. A trial should therefore compare waste alongside waiting times and whether children feel they have enough food. The lowest waste figure is not automatically the best result.
paragraphs.chinese: 少做可能让晚到学生无饭可吃；先给小份、允许追加又需要人手和合理队列。试行应同时看浪费、等候和是否吃够，最低浪费未必最佳。

paragraphs.english: Pupils can also provide useful feedback about dishes they routinely leave untouched. However, replacing every unfamiliar vegetable with a popular snack would change the purpose of the meal service. An effective policy balances preferences, adequate meals and the resources available. It should test a manageable change, record its consequences and revise it where necessary. Reducing the amount thrown away is an important aim, but it cannot stand alone as the complete definition of a successful lunch.
paragraphs.chinese: 学生口味反馈有用，但不能把陌生蔬菜全换成零食。应兼顾偏好、足够的餐食和资源，小范围试验并调整，而非只追求少扔食物。

articles.title: When Waste Reduction Changes the Denominator

paragraphs.english: Businesses frequently present declining food waste as evidence of improved sustainability. Yet the interpretation of that decline depends on what has happened elsewhere in the system. A supermarket may discard fewer vegetables after transferring near-expiry stock to a charitable distributor; whether less food is ultimately wasted then depends on the distributor's storage, transport and ability to match supply with demand. The original retailer's indicator has improved, but the underlying problem may have been displaced rather than resolved. A boundary chosen for reporting can quietly become a boundary for responsibility.
paragraphs.chinese: 企业浪费量下降不必然意味着整体改善。超市把临期蔬菜交给公益机构后，最终是否少浪费还取决于储运与供需匹配。问题可能只是转移，报告边界也可能变成责任边界。

paragraphs.english: Similar complications arise when success is expressed as waste per unit sold. If sales expand while the proportion discarded falls, the absolute quantity of discarded food need not fall with it. Neither measure is inherently sufficient: the ratio describes operating efficiency, whereas the total describes the scale of the remaining loss. Comparing organisations without explaining this distinction invites judgements that the evidence cannot support. It can also create incentives to favour easily measured transfers over less visible work, such as coordinating orders with actual demand or helping staff identify why certain products are repeatedly left unsold.
paragraphs.chinese: 每销售单位浪费比例下降时，总销量增长仍可能使废弃总量上升。比例看效率，总量看损失规模，不能混用。指标还可能鼓励容易统计的转移，忽视订货协调等工作。

paragraphs.english: A more credible assessment would follow food through the proposed intervention and state the constraints on doing so. Donations may provide valuable assistance even when their effects on waste are uncertain; acknowledging that uncertainty does not invalidate the social benefit. It prevents that benefit from being used as proof of a different claim. Independent scrutiny should ask who performs the additional labour, whether recipients can decline unsuitable deliveries, and which losses remain outside the published figures. Reducing waste requires an account of consequences across the chain, rather than confidence that a favourable number at one point describes the whole.
paragraphs.chinese: 可信评估应追踪干预后的食物流向并交代限制。捐赠有社会价值，但不能自动证明减少浪费。还应审视谁承担额外劳动、接收者能否拒绝不适合的食物以及遗漏的损失。

articles.title: Repairability Starts Before a Product Breaks

paragraphs.english: Two desk lamps may have similar prices and brightness, yet very different costs over their useful lives. One allows its switch and cable to be replaced; the other seals both inside its base. A buyer cannot evaluate repairability merely by looking at how attractive the lamp appears. Access to parts, instructions and a suitable repair service can matter as much as the durability of the materials themselves.
paragraphs.chinese: 两盏价格和亮度相近的灯，长期成本可能不同。可否换开关、电线，以及配件、说明和维修服务是否可得，比外观更能体现可维修性。

paragraphs.english: A community workshop illustrates the difference. Volunteers can diagnose a loose connection, but they cannot safely complete every electrical repair. When a manufacturer supplies compatible parts and clear documentation, a qualified specialist has a better chance of returning the item to use. Without that support, a technically simple fault may still lead to replacement. The barrier is not necessarily a lack of skill: it may be the way the product and its supply chain have been organised.
paragraphs.chinese: 志愿者能诊断松动连接，却不能安全处理所有电器故障。有兼容配件和清晰文档，合格人员更容易修复；否则简单故障也会导致换新，问题可能在设计和供应链。

paragraphs.english: An effective purchasing decision therefore considers maintenance before failure occurs. A cheaper item may remain a reasonable choice when resources are limited, so repairable design should not become a demand that every buyer spend more immediately. However, institutions buying many items could compare expected servicing needs as well as purchase prices. That approach creates a clearer incentive for suppliers to support repairs. Keeping products useful requires both appropriate expertise and conditions that allow that expertise to be applied.
paragraphs.chinese: 购买前应考虑维护，但不能要求预算紧的人立即买贵产品。批量采购机构可比较维护需求和购价，促使供应商支持维修；技能还需要能施展的条件。

articles.title: Who Benefits from a Product That Cannot Be Opened?
articles.subtitle: 修理物品，也重新理解物品的价值
articles.provenance: AI 原创全文分级重写 · 2026-10-13 · 参考 CEFR 阅读描述；未作教学标定，非官方真题

paragraphs.english: The inability to repair a product is often framed as an unfortunate technical consequence of making it smaller or cheaper. Sometimes that explanation is credible: a compact design may impose genuine constraints. Yet treating all sealed construction as inevitable overlooks the commercial incentives that shape it. A device whose minor components cannot be replaced may generate another sale sooner than one supported by accessible parts. The issue is therefore not simply whether engineers could have chosen differently, but whether the organisation had any reason to value a longer period of use.
paragraphs.chinese: 不可维修常被解释为小型化、降成本的技术代价，有时确有约束，但也可能受商业激励影响：小部件不能更换会促成更早换购。应问企业为何重视或不重视延长使用。

paragraphs.english: A repairability rating can expose part of this problem, although its interpretation requires scrutiny. A product may be easy to open while its replacement components remain prohibitively expensive or disappear after a short period. Conversely, a repair that requires specialist equipment may still be practical if affordable service is widely available. Counting screws or measuring disassembly time offers useful evidence, but neither establishes that an ordinary owner can obtain a lasting repair. The assessment must connect physical design with the institutions through which parts, knowledge and skilled labour are supplied.
paragraphs.chinese: 维修评分需要审视。容易拆开不代表配件便宜且长期可买；需专用工具也不代表维修不实际。螺丝数量或拆解时间只是部分证据，还须联系配件、知识和服务供给。

paragraphs.english: Responsibility is also unevenly distributed. Advising consumers to choose repairable products presumes that they can identify those products and afford the initial price. It may shift the burden towards buyers without altering the practices that restrict their options. A more persuasive framework would examine what manufacturers undertake to support, how long that commitment lasts and whether independent repairers can participate. This does not imply that every product should be preserved indefinitely or that every repair is worthwhile. It means that decisions about replacement should follow an informed judgement about feasible alternatives, rather than emerge from a market in which those alternatives have quietly been designed away.
paragraphs.chinese: 只劝消费者选可维修产品，假设他们能识别且负担购价，可能把责任转给买方。更好的评估看厂家支持承诺、时限及独立维修者参与。不要求无限保存产品，而是让更换基于可行替代方案。

paragraphs.english: A community garden committee must decide how to use a narrow area beside its entrance. Some residents want more vegetables, while others request a path wide enough for wheelchairs. A third group wants seating for visitors who do not garden. These proposals reveal different meanings of participation: growing food is only one way of using a shared site. A vote that counts only active growers would miss the interests of many other residents.
paragraphs.chinese: 花园入口空地有人想种菜，有人要轮椅通道，还有人要座椅。参与并不只等于种植，仅让种菜者投票会遗漏其他居民。

paragraphs.english: The committee sketches several alternatives. A wider path would reduce planting space, but it could improve access to the remaining beds. Raised containers might make some tasks easier, although their cost and maintenance would require additional resources. Seating could encourage social visits, yet its location should not block the entrance. Rather than describe one option as universally beneficial, the committee needs to identify who gains and which constraints remain.
paragraphs.chinese: 宽路减少种植空间却改善可达性；高位种植箱方便部分任务却有成本；座椅利于交往但不能堵门。应说明谁受益和仍有哪些限制。

paragraphs.english: A temporary arrangement offers evidence before a larger investment. Movable seats and marked pathways allow residents to test the layout during ordinary visits. Feedback should include people who previously avoided the garden, since existing users cannot fully explain what kept others away. The eventual plan may still involve disagreement. However, a decision based on actual use and openly discussed trade-offs has a stronger claim to represent the community than a layout chosen solely by those already comfortable within it.
paragraphs.chinese: 可移动座椅和标线能先试用，收集含以往不来者的反馈。即使仍有分歧，依据实际使用、公开取舍的方案比仅由现有使用者决定更能代表社区。

articles.title: The Hidden Rules of a Shared Garden

paragraphs.english: Shared gardens are often celebrated as spaces in which cooperation develops naturally. The description is attractive, but it risks treating a designed institution as an uncomplicated extension of neighbourly goodwill. Rules about opening hours, acceptable plants and the distribution of harvests determine who can participate and on what terms. Even the expectation that members attend a weekly meeting favours residents whose work and caring responsibilities permit them to do so. A space can be collectively owned while its everyday arrangements remain more convenient for some people than for others.
paragraphs.chinese: 共享花园并不会自然产生公平合作。开放时间、允许的植物、收获分配和会议要求都决定参与条件，固定周会尤其偏向有空的人。共同所有不等于安排对人人便利。

paragraphs.english: These inequalities become visible when a group allocates plots according to the amount of volunteer labour contributed. The criterion appears to reward commitment, yet it assumes that hours freely available are a fair measure of commitment. Someone working irregular shifts may care deeply about the garden while being unable to attend scheduled sessions. Conversely, abandoning all contribution requirements may place an unreasonable burden on a small number of regular volunteers. Neither position resolves the trade-off between sustaining the project and avoiding exclusion; the implications depend on how different forms of participation are recognised.
paragraphs.chinese: 按劳动时数分配地块似乎奖励投入，却假设空闲时间能衡量承诺，忽略不规律工作者。取消贡献要求又可能让少数人过度负担，需权衡持续运营与避免排斥。

paragraphs.english: An equitable framework might acknowledge tasks performed away from the site, allow flexible contributions and reserve some produce for neighbours who cannot garden themselves. These arrangements would still require negotiation, record keeping and resources. Their value lies less in promising harmony than in making the underlying choices open to scrutiny. Disagreement need not demonstrate that the garden has failed: it may reveal whose needs earlier routines overlooked. Assessing success solely through harvested weight or membership numbers would miss that institutional learning. The more demanding question is whether residents can influence the rules that shape their access, including those whose circumstances make conventional membership difficult.
paragraphs.chinese: 可承认场外任务、灵活贡献并给不能种植者留部分收获，但仍需协商和资源。价值在于公开选择而非保证和谐。分歧可能揭示遗漏需求；成功还应看居民能否影响准入规则。

articles.title: Conservation and Unequal Control

paragraphs.english: Household conservation campaigns commonly address everyone as an equally capable decision maker. That assumption is questionable in rented housing, where occupants may pay for water without controlling the equipment through which it flows. A message urging individual restraint can obscure the distribution of authority, particularly when a persistent leak has already been reported but remains unrepaired.
paragraphs.chinese: 节水宣传假设家庭都能自主决定，但租户可能付水费却不控制设施。漏水已报未修时，要求个人克制会掩盖权限差异。

paragraphs.english: Consumption figures do not resolve this problem by themselves. A household using more water may contain more residents or require additional necessary cleaning; a lower total may reflect prolonged absence rather than efficient equipment. Indicators that ignore these circumstances create incentives to judge people on outcomes they only partly control. They also risk turning a collective maintenance failure into an apparently personal deficiency.
paragraphs.chinese: 高用量可能来自人数和必要清洁，低用量可能来自外出。忽略情境会把部分不可控结果当作个人缺陷，把维护失败个人化。

paragraphs.english: An equitable assessment would connect responsibility with the practical capacity to act. Residents could document faults, while owners would disclose repair times and equipment changes. Such a framework would neither dismiss the value of careful habits nor guarantee that every reduction is affordable. Its purpose would be to make the constraints visible and prevent conservation from becoming a demand imposed most heavily on those with the fewest alternatives. Scrutiny should follow the source of avoidable loss, rather than stop at the person receiving the bill.
paragraphs.chinese: 公平评估应把责任与行动能力相连：住户记录故障，业主披露维修情况。目的不是否认习惯价值，而是公开限制，追踪可避免损失的来源。

paragraphs.english: Libraries frequently prioritise resources according to recorded borrowing. This seems responsive to demand, yet the indicator presupposes that potential readers already have access to something they want to borrow. articles.title: The Illusion of Vocabulary Ownership
articles.subtitle: 在语境中积累词汇，而不只背列表
articles.provenance: AI 原创全文分级重写 · 2026-10-13 · 参考 CEFR 阅读描述；未作教学标定，非官方真题

paragraphs.english: Knowing a word is frequently treated as a binary achievement, as though recognition transfers it permanently into a learner's possession. In practice, knowledge is distributed across meaning, register, pronunciation and the contexts in which an expression can be retrieved. A learner may interpret a term correctly in an article while hesitating to use it in speech, or may produce it fluently in a familiar phrase without recognising its implications elsewhere.
paragraphs.chinese: 词汇知识不是非会即不会，还包括语域、发音、提取情境。能读懂不等于能说，熟悉短语也不保证理解其他用法。

paragraphs.english: This complexity complicates both teaching incentives and assessment. A rapidly expanding list offers a visible measure of progress, whereas the gradual refinement of existing knowledge is harder to display. The resulting emphasis can reward breadth at the expense of flexible access. Yet the opposite extreme, demanding complete mastery before introducing another term, would also misrepresent how language develops through incomplete and repeated encounters.
paragraphs.chinese: 词量增长容易展示，知识细化难展示，激励可能偏向广度；但要求完全掌握后才学新词也不符合渐进学习。

paragraphs.english: A defensible framework therefore treats vocabulary learning as revisable understanding. Learners revisit expressions in contrasting contexts and explain why a particular choice fits one situation better than another. Such tasks cannot provide a perfectly objective total of words owned. They can, however, supply evidence of increasing sensitivity to meaning and use. The relevant question becomes not simply whether a term has been encountered, but which kinds of interpretation and communication that encounter has made possible.
paragraphs.chinese: 应把词汇知识视为可修正理解，在对比语境中解释选择。虽不能精确数拥有多少词，却能看对意义和用法的敏感度。

articles.title: Flexibility and the Transfer of Responsibility

paragraphs.english: The promise of learning anywhere and at any time makes online education appear to remove the constraints of the classroom. It often relocates them instead. Learners must secure a quiet space, reliable connectivity and time that other responsibilities do not consume. Where institutions once organised these conditions, individuals may now be expected to provide them, with very unequal resources.
paragraphs.chinese: 随时随地学习常把课堂约束转给个人：安静空间、网络和不被占用的时间，而资源很不均等。

paragraphs.english: Low participation can consequently be interpreted too narrowly as a lack of motivation. Platform records show whether a video was opened, but not whether an interruption came from care work, inaccessible instructions or unsuitable equipment. An assessment built entirely around those records risks converting contextual obstacles into personal deficiencies. The incentives then favour reminders and rewards for visible activity rather than changes to the conditions that prevent meaningful study.
paragraphs.chinese: 低参与可能被误读为不努力，平台记录看不到照护、指令和设备障碍，激励便偏向催促可见活动。

paragraphs.english: This does not negate the substantial value of flexible access. It requires a more explicit account of whom flexibility benefits and what support remains necessary. A defensible design offers alternative formats, manageable tasks and opportunities for clarification, while testing whether these provisions address actual barriers. Success cannot be inferred solely from enrolment or completion totals. The stronger question is whether learners with different circumstances can translate nominal access into sustained opportunities to understand, practise and receive useful feedback.
paragraphs.chinese: 灵活有价值，但要交代受益对象和支持：替代格式、可做任务、答疑并验证门槛是否降低。名义准入需变成持续理解、练习和反馈机会。

paragraphs.english: Fact checking is often imagined as a method for dividing claims into true and false. Many public arguments resist that division because their force depends on selection, framing and unstated comparison. A figure can be accurate while the conclusion attached to it remains misleading. The relevant task is then to examine what the evidence permits, rather than merely confirm that a number appears in an original document.
paragraphs.chinese: 数字准确也可能被选择和框架导向误导结论，核查须问证据支持什么。

paragraphs.english: Consider a report describing an increase in public complaints as proof of declining service quality. Complaints may indeed reveal deterioration, but easier reporting procedures could also make existing dissatisfaction more visible. The indicator cannot settle its own interpretation. Nor would demonstrating this alternative explanation prove that quality has remained unchanged; it establishes a limit on the initial inference.
paragraphs.chinese: 投诉增多可能是服务下降，也可能是报告更便利；后一可能只限制推断，不证明质量没变。

paragraphs.english: A disciplined response preserves these distinctions when communicating uncertainty. It identifies the source, explains the assumption connecting observation to conclusion and asks what additional evidence would discriminate between plausible accounts. This process is slower than attaching a simple label, and it may disappoint readers seeking immediate certainty. Its value lies in preventing verification from becoming another form of overstatement: confirming one component of an argument should not silently authenticate every implication presented alongside it.
paragraphs.chinese: 应说明来源、连接观察与结论的假设及所需证据。虽慢且未必给确定答案，却避免核实一个数字就认可整套论证。

paragraphs.english: An organisation records training as complete whenever an employee attends a demonstration. Attendance is easy to document, but it does not establish competence. paragraphs.english: Training failures are frequently attributed to employees who did not follow instructions. That explanation may be justified in a particular case, but it can obscure organisational conditions that make compliance difficult. Instructions developed around an ideal workflow may not account for interruptions, unavailable equipment or conflicting demands. A learner's mistake then becomes the visible endpoint of constraints that the training never addressed.
paragraphs.chinese: 培训失败不都源于不守指令，理想流程可能忽视打断、设备不足和冲突要求。

paragraphs.english: Assessment conducted only under controlled conditions can reinforce this blind spot. It establishes that a task is possible within the demonstration, not that the same procedure remains feasible during ordinary work. Incentives to report rapid completion may further discourage supervisors from documenting unresolved difficulties. The institution acquires evidence of attendance while losing evidence about the limits of its own preparation.
paragraphs.chinese: 受控评估只证明示范环境可做，快速完成激励还可能掩盖未解困难，机构只剩出席证据。

paragraphs.english: A credible framework would examine both individual competence and the conditions required to apply it. Employees should practise identifying uncertainty and escalating problems, while the organisation reviews whether tools, time and responsibilities support the stated procedure. This does not dissolve personal accountability. It distributes scrutiny more accurately, preventing instruction from becoming a way to transfer all responsibility for failure to the least powerful participant in the process.
paragraphs.chinese: 应同时评估能力和应用条件，练识别不确定、上报问题，机构查工具时间职责；不是取消个人责任，而是避免全推给弱势执行者。

paragraphs.english: Recruitment procedures often reward applicants who can translate experience into the institution's preferred language. paragraphs.english: Explicit criteria can reduce this ambiguity, but their interpretation still deserves scrutiny. It would also acknowledge the constraints of any brief application. This does not imply that all experience is equally suitable; it requires judgements to follow explained relationships with the work, rather than assumptions about the prestige of the setting in which a skill was developed.

Residents need opportunities to explain an overlooked need without being treated as unwilling to cooperate. Such procedures cannot remove scarce housing or every interpersonal conflict. paragraphs.english: Automated assessment often gains authority from the appearance of impartial calculation. paragraphs.english: Public artworks are sometimes expected to embody a community's identity, as though that identity were already settled and could be translated into one visible form. The expectation conceals disagreement about whose experiences should be represented. An object can become contested not because it lacks meaning, but because its meaning appears to privilege one account of the place.

paragraphs.english: Consultation broadens the evidence available, yet its legitimacy depends on how responses influence the decision. Collecting comments while leaving the central choices inaccessible may create an appearance of participation without transferring any authority. Equally, a simple majority does not necessarily protect perspectives held by smaller groups.
paragraphs.chinese: 收意见若不影响核心选择只是参与外观，多数也不保护少数。

paragraphs.english: A defensible framework would explain the proposal's purpose, the constraints on revision and the reasons for the final judgement. It would allow disagreement to remain visible rather than present the installation as proof of universal belonging. This does not require an artwork to satisfy every interpretation. It recognises public art as an intervention in a shared conversation, whose accountability depends partly on how that conversation was invited and heard.
paragraphs.chinese: 公开目的限制与理由，保留异议，把作品视为公共对话干预而非全民认同证明。

paragraphs.english: Community histories often acquire authority by presenting themselves as collective memory. Yet the people able and willing to contribute are not necessarily representative of everyone who lived through the events. The archive reflects decisions about whom to contact, what to ask and which accounts to preserve, as well as the experiences described.
paragraphs.chinese: 集体记忆的权威受联系人、提问和保存选择影响，贡献者未必代表全部。

paragraphs.english: Absence consequently requires careful interpretation. A group missing from the record may have been overlooked, unavailable or reluctant to participate in the terms offered. Treating silence as evidence that its experience was unimportant would turn a limitation of collection into a claim about the past. The same risk arises when contradictory accounts are edited into an apparently unified narrative.
paragraphs.chinese: 缺席可能源于遗漏和参与条件，不能把收集局限当往昔不重要。

paragraphs.english: An accountable framework would document selection, preserve relevant disagreement and distinguish established events from uncertain recollections. This does not dismiss memory or demand impossible completeness. It makes the conditions of representation open to scrutiny. A history then remains capable of revision, recognising that the coherence of its published account may owe as much to editorial choices as to agreement among those whose lives it describes.
paragraphs.chinese: 公开选择、保留分歧、区分事实回忆，让历史可修订，连贯也可能来自编辑而非共同认同。

paragraphs.english: Participatory budgeting is often justified through the authority of a collective choice. Yet a vote aggregates expressed preferences, not every relevant need. People excluded by timing, language or confidence remain absent from the total, while a group capable of organising support may make its priorities especially visible.

paragraphs.english: Criteria can improve deliberation, although their selection also requires judgement. Maximising the number of beneficiaries might favour a widely used amenity over an essential improvement for a smaller group. Neither outcome is automatically equitable. The trade-off cannot be settled merely by describing the procedure as democratic, since the implications depend on what participation and benefit mean in that setting.
paragraphs.chinese: 最多受益者标准可能忽视少数必需改进，民主程序不自动解决公平。

paragraphs.english: An accountable framework would explain criteria, widen practical access and preserve a record of unmet needs. It would assess implementation as well as the moment of voting. This does not guarantee consensus or remove budget constraints. It makes the decision open to scrutiny and distinguishes an opportunity to express a preference from a continuing capacity to influence how shared resources respond to the community's different circumstances.
